name: Miriam
source: Miriam is a girl with very frail condition, [url=https://vndb.org/c9014]Minette[/url] found her when she was having an attack and since then, they have become very good friends. She lives with her cat, who's chief of the neighborhood cats, and her older brother, who cares for her.
